title: KeyVault API — Unlimited Key Checks
objective: Partner API keys are short and this endpoint has no rate limit at all. Find a valid key.

verifier.condition: A valid partner API key is found after more validation attempts than any reasonable rate limit would have allowed.

weakness: The key-validation endpoint has no attempt limiting of any kind, and the key format is short enough to be exhaustively searched in a bounded amount of time.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /api/partners/validate-key (no attempt limiting of any kind)
seededData: One partner API key in the format PK-NNNN (a 4-digit code), different each instance.
hints: Try a handful of wrong keys in a row. Does anything about the response change — a delay, a lockout, a CAPTCHA?
The key format is short and entirely numeric in its variable part. How many possibilities does that leave?
Script the attempts — this isn't meant to be done by hand.
burpNotes: Use Intruder with a 4-digit numeric payload (0000-9999) against the key parameter, or script it directly.
